get.summary: Get available booking slots for a given date
get.description: Returns all 30-minute slots between 09:00–18:00 for a date, marking each as available or taken. Pass `serviceId` to account for service duration (e.g. a 90-min service cannot start at 17:30).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date to check in YYYY-MM-DD format

parameters.name: serviceId
parameters.description: Service UUID — used to calculate duration overlap

200.description: Slot availability for the requested date

open.description: false if closed that day (e.g. Sunday)

400.description: Invalid date / date in the past

get.summary: Get appointments (Customers see their own, Admins see all)

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Admin only — filter by customer ID

post.description: Bookings are restricted to Mon–Sat, 09:00–18:00. The chosen time slot plus service duration must end by 18:00.

400.description: Outside business hours or closed day

put.description: Same business hours rules apply as booking. Re-sets status to PENDING.
